t1.RELEASE_NO: key: picks the newest edition when two share a date (history_releases 1)
t1.RELEASE_DATE: key: newest edition: selects its rows
t1.ROW: key: row order; labels are found by text and not by row number
t1.C01: skip: second-hand trend, % change on previous month
t1.C02: skip: second-hand trend (the total's trend line is shown)
t1.C04: chart-monthly, chart-ytd, insight:latest, insight:ytd — second-hand dwellings sold, original data
t1.C05: chart-monthly, chart-ytd, chart-sub, kpi:sub, insight:sub, insight:latest — thereof new dwellings sold under government subsidy
t1.C06: skip: new dwellings trend, % change on previous month
t1.C07: skip: new dwellings trend (t5 carries it since 2016)
t1.C09: chart-monthly, chart-ytd, chart-sub, kpi:sub, insight:latest, insight:sub — new dwellings sold, original data
t1.C10: skip: total trend, % change on previous month
t1.C11: chart-monthly, insight:trend — total dwellings sold, trend
t1.C13: chart-monthly, chart-ytd, kpi:sold, kpi:yoy, insight:latest, insight:ytd — total dwellings sold, original data (also the full-year rows)
t1.C17: chart-monthly — year label (carried down; a year without a month is a full-year row)
t2.RELEASE_NO: key: picks the newest edition when two share a date (history_releases 1)
t2.RELEASE_DATE: key: newest edition: selects its rows
t2.ROW: key: row order; labels are found by text and not by row number
t2.C01: chart-stock, kpi:supply, insight:stock — months of supply at the trend sales rate
t2.C02: skip: stock trend, % change on previous month
t2.C03: chart-stock — new dwellings still for sale, trend
t2.C05: kpi:stock, insight:stock — new dwellings still for sale, original data
t4.RELEASE_NO: key: picks the newest edition when two share a date (history_releases 1)
t4.RELEASE_DATE: key: newest edition: selects its rows
t4.ROW: key: row order; labels are found by text and not by row number
t4.C01: skip: in the current layout chart 1 (sales of the last six months, original data), which t1 already holds; read only to identify the sheet by its title, since chart sheets moved between stems
t4.C02: skip: chart 1 month number (t1 has the same months)
t4.C04: skip: chart 1 new non-subsidised sales (= t1.C09 minus t1.C05)
t5.RELEASE_NO: key: picks the newest edition when two share a date (history_releases 1)
t5.RELEASE_DATE: key: newest edition: selects its rows
t5.ROW: key: row order; labels are found by text and not by row number
t5.C01: chart-trend — year label (chart 2: sales trend since 2016; found by title, any of t4-t8)
t5.C03: chart-trend, insight:peak — total dwellings sold, trend
t6.RELEASE_NO: key: picks the newest edition when two share a date (history_releases 1)
t6.RELEASE_DATE: key: newest edition: selects its rows
t6.ROW: key: row order; labels are found by text and not by row number
t6.C01: chart-stock — year label (chart 3: stock trend since 2019; optional, found by title)
t6.C03: chart-stock — new dwellings still for sale, trend
t7.RELEASE_NO: key: picks the newest edition when two share a date (history_releases 1)
t7.RELEASE_DATE: key: newest edition: selects its rows
t7.ROW: key: row order; labels are found by text and not by row number
t7.C01: chart-district, insight:district — district name (chart 4, found by title)
t7.C02: chart-district, insight:district — new dwellings still for sale
t8.RELEASE_NO: key: picks the newest edition when two share a date (history_releases 1)
t8.RELEASE_DATE: key: newest edition: selects its rows
t8.ROW: key: row order; labels are found by text and not by row number
t8.C01: chart-cities, insight:cities — city name (chart 5: cities over 100k residents, found by title)
t8.C02: chart-cities, insight:cities — new dwellings still for sale
releases.RELEASE_DATE: text: the latest-edition card: publication date
releases.TITLE: text: the latest-edition card
releases.HEADLINE: text: the latest-edition card: CBS's one-line summary when it has one
releases.PAGE_URL: text: link to the release on cbs.gov.il
releases.REPORT_PDF_URL: text: link to the written report (PDF)
